validated_post_race_condition_fix_2026_0.notes: All 4 previously-failing runs (007/009/013/024) now pass. Root cause: the original imu_state_mutex_ guard (bc3761c) only covered one estimator's states_ push/pop; promoted to EstimatorBase (estimator_state_mutex_, recursive) and extended to the ImuEstimatorBase cache, the covariances_ map, graph_->solve() vs concurrent reads, and every multi-threaded estimator's states_ shift -- see research/UPSTREAM_FIDELITY.md. Also fixed in this pass: the stress harness's segfault/sparsify checks used `rg`, which silently disappears from PATH once the ROS2 setup scripts are sourced -- every run in this batch actually had ~1700-2000 real 'Sparsifying measurements' log lines (backend-overload sparsify still happens under load, same as before) that the old rg-based check never saw; switched to grep.
